share_summary: The Khutbah of Arafah calls Muslims to hold fast to tawhid, perform the Hajj rites with sincerity, and return home with renewed faith and unity.
summary: This Khutbah of Arafah opens with praise of Allah and a call to taqwa, emphasizing that the greatest preparation for the hereafter is tawhid, worshipping Allah alone and avoiding all forms of shirk. The khatib outlines the pillars of Islam and stresses the importance of patience, gratitude, and obedience to Allah's universal laws in creation. A detailed account of the Hajj rites follows, from the standing at Arafah and the combined prayers to the stoning of the Jamarat, the sacrifice, shaving, and the farewell tawaf, all while urging pilgrims to maintain calmness, follow official guidance, and keep Hajj free from political slogans and partisan calls. The khutbah highlights that Hajj is a manifestation of unity, brotherhood, and solidarity among Muslims of all backgrounds and colors. It closes with heartfelt supplications for the pilgrims, for the Muslim Ummah, and for the leadership of Saudi Arabia, asking Allah to accept the rites and return every pilgrim home safe and victorious.
chunk_translations: All praise is due to Allah. All praise is due to Allah, the Sovereign, the Most Holy, the Source of Peace. He made the pilgrimage to His Sacred House obligatory upon the Muslims and made it one of the pillars of the religion of Islam.
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, the Sovereign, the All-Knowing. And I bear witness that our Prophet and master Muhammad is His servant and messenger, the best of all creation.
Upon him, and upon his family, his companions, and his followers, be the finest prayers and the most complete salutations. To proceed:
O people, hold fast to the taqwa of Allah, for in it lies the salvation of the servant in his hereafter. Allah says at the opening of Surah Al-Hajj: O people
And part of the taqwa of Allah is preparing for the Day of Resurrection by performing acts of obedience and abandoning sins and evil deeds. Allah says:
And the greatest preparation for the hereafter is through tawhid, worshipping Allah alone, and abandoning the invocation of any other. And how can he invoke
Allah says:
The motto and the motto of the people of faith is tawhid, declaring Allah's oneness. Allah says: Your god is one God

These are the pillars of the religion of Islam: tawhid, bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing Salah, giving Zakat, fasting Ramadan, and performing the Hajj to the Sacred House of Allah. Along with the exhortation to fear Allah. Allah says:
And patience in obedience to Allah and in the face of painful decrees. Allah says:
Along with gratitude to Allah for His blessings. Along with gratitude to Allah for His blessings.
Allah says: Thus have We subjected them to you so that you may be grateful. And Allah has, in His creation, universal laws that the servant must believe in and benefit from. Allah says:
And He says:
And among that is His saying: How many a town have We destroyed while it was doing wrong, so that it lies in ruins, with its wells abandoned and its lofty castles empty. And how many a town
Indeed, Allah, Glorified and Exalted, commanded His close friend Ibrahim, peace be upon him, to call the people to Hajj. Allah says:
cattle. Yes. Yes,
The pilgrims have come. The pilgrims have come from every distant pass. To perform the rites seeking Allah's pleasure and His reward, venerating the Ancient House and the sacred sites. Allah says:
They flock, they flock to these blessed places in answer to the call of tawhid, to single out Allah in worship and to abandon associating partners with Him. Allah says:
and those who bow and prostrate. The House is purified, the House is purified of everything that does not befit its status, so there is no
No political slogans and no partisan calls, but rather submission to Allah, submission to Allah, and following, following His Prophet, peace be upon him.
And purity, rather purity in the outward and the inward, fulfilling covenants and pledges, and respecting rights. Allah says:

And Hajj manifests, Hajj manifests the aspects of acquaintance, mutual affection, cooperation, and solidarity among the people of Islam in performing the rites, despite the differences in their colors and their countries, brothers loving one another, witnessing benefits for themselves.
And that they feed from their sacrificial animals the poor and the destitute, and that their character be one of excellence in deeds and truthfulness in words.
Allah says: And avoid false speech. At the station of Arafah. At the station of Arafah, Allah boasts of you before His angels, and it is the great station in which Allah revealed:

So follow, follow the Prophet of guidance, peace be upon him. He prayed Dhuhr and Asr combined and shortened, then he stood in remembrance of Allah until the sun had set, and then he proceeded to Muzdalifah, as Allah says: And when you have departed
When the morning of Eid came, when the morning of Eid came, he proceeded to Mina. Allah says:
He stoned Jamrat al-Aqabah, sacrificed his animal, shaved his head and permitted the cutting of hair as an alternative, and then performed tawaf around the House. Allah says:

While maintaining calmness, gentleness, and avoiding crowding, and following the instructions of the organizing authorities, and adhering to the crowd-flow management and movement routes, so as to achieve the common good and to avoid harm and chaos.
And to preserve lives and to facilitate the performance of the rites. In Mina it is recommended to increase the remembrance of Allah. Allah says:

During the days of Tashriq, the pilgrim stones the three Jamarat, each with seven pebbles each day. The better option is to remain until the thirteenth day, though it is permitted to depart early on the twelfth day. Allah says:
And before, before departing, the Farewell Tawaf. For Allah is the One, Allah is the One who has chosen you
And part of holding fast to Allah is that a person increases his supplication to his Lord, especially in the places of Hajj, for they are occasions where supplication is likely to be answered.

And according to the Hadith, the best supplication is the supplication of the Day of Arafah, and the best that I and the Prophets before me have said on the Day of Arafah is: There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner, to Him belongs all dominion and all praise, and He has power over all things.
Narrated by al-Tirmidhi. And Allah says:
And Allah says:
O Allah, accept from the pilgrims their supplications and their rites, make their affairs easy, forgive their sins, and return them to their homelands safe, rewarded, and successful.
O Allah, set right the affairs of the Muslims and unite their word upon the truth. O Allah, set right the affairs of the Muslims and unite their word upon the truth.
O Allah, set right the affairs of the Muslims and unite their word upon the truth. Take charge of all their affairs and set right their religious and worldly conditions.
Take charge of all their affairs and set right their religious and worldly conditions, O Lord of all the worlds.
O Allah, grant success to the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, King Salman bin Abdulaziz, and his Crown Prince, Prince Muhammad bin Salman.

Reward them with the best of rewards in this world and the hereafter. For they have done good to Your servants, made it easy for the pilgrims to perform the rites, and given generously in the service of the Two Holy Mosques and those who visit them.

O Allah, grant victory through them to Your religion. O Allah, grant victory through them to Your religion. And may Allah's prayers and peace be upon our master and Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and companions, a most abundant salutation.
